title: SweepCreate
description: Start a sensitivity discovery sweep on a session's car and track (docs/adr/0032-sensitivity-discovery-sweeps.md): one setting moved step by step, each step an A-B-A-B experiment the AI drives against the same baseline, at a pinned AI hint.

parameter.description: Setup item to sweep. A member of a linked group sweeps the whole group (ADR 0026).

steps.description: Clicks from the baseline, in the order they are driven, e.g. [-1, 1, 2, 3]. Each is clipped to the item's range; a step that clipping makes 0 or a repeat is skipped and said so.

ai_hint_share.description: The share of the car's own AI tyre hint pinned for every step (ADR 0028). Required: a sweep compares steps driven at one hint.
